catalog.nvfp4Search: Blackwell GPU Ɗum heɓirta ɗum e ko ɓuri anndeeki. NVFP4 Ɗu'um waaway waɗaago to akitekca e injiiji ɗin mballita ɗum. FLUX.2 Klein 4B Comfy loading e woodi nder fellere; laara. CUDA PyTorchNaftoraaki kare kuutinirɗe nder ɓamtaare naa tabbitinii wakkatiire huutinirki koo boo na tabbitinii jaawal.
catalog.nvfp4Prefer: NVFP4 e hollaama ngam GPU e FLUX.2 Klein 4B iyalji. Native loading yiɗi Comfy layout, CUDA PyTorch e ko ɗum yiɗi. Suɓi foomula, Qwen3 encoder e VAE feere-feere nder taskaramji wadduki. Runtime, kawtal manngal, e ɓeydal hakkilanoojum e yiɗi hollaaki.
catalog.nvfp4Check: NVFP4 heɓaama: GPU wallitaaki, hakkilanki, darnde darnde koo bo wallitaaki aarkitekturwal naa tabbitinaama. Laara CUDA injiniya bako suɓol kala feerootirnde nde'e. Fiiraaki go'o waɗataako ko haandi.
catalog.nvfp4Unsupported: Native NVFP4 naa ɗum yiɗiiɗum e ko yi'etee GPU maa boo ko woni jooni ko walaa VRAM. Tabbitinii ko nanndi e GGUF quantization maa boo ko nanndi e injiniyaare. Ɗum laawol naa ɗum hokkay native FP4 accelerator.
catalog.quantQualityAdvice: Novera GGUF Naftirki haalaji, hootoji be video components: Q6_K ko bo ko ɓuri ɗum ko ɗum yiɗi to ɗum fuɗɗi ko ɗum yiɗi. Q4_K_M Ɗu'um ɗum ko yi'etee, naa ɗum darorde goonga nde fuu maaje; wattamji ɗin e daranii dow misaaluuji e kuuɗe ɗen. NVFP4 e kadin goɗɗi ɗate kuumtaaki e ngoodi ko haandi e ko haandi e ko haandi.
